questions.q: What is the capital of Nauru?
questions.why: Yaren is the seat of government.

questions.q: What is the smallest island country in the world?
questions.why: It is about 21 square kilometres.

questions.q: Which mineral made Nauru rich in the 1970s?
questions.why: It came from ancient bird droppings.

questions.q: Which currency does Nauru use?
questions.why: It has never had its own currency.

questions.q: In which year did Nauru become independent?
questions.why: It had been run by Australia.

questions.q: Which ocean is Nauru in?
questions.why: It is just south of the equator.

questions.q: Which country runs an offshore detention centre on Nauru?
questions.why: It holds asylum seekers.

questions.q: What did a British captain name Nauru in 1798?
questions.why: Germany annexed it in 1888.

questions.q: Which country ruled Nauru before 1914?
questions.why: Australia took over in the First World War.

questions.q: Who was Nauru's first President?
questions.why: He led it for most of its first 20 years.

questions.q: Which country occupied Nauru in the Second World War?
questions.why: Many Nauruans were deported to Chuuk.

questions.q: What problem does Nauru have with its people's health?
questions.why: Imported food changed diets.

questions.q: Which weightlifter later became President of Nauru?
questions.why: He won Commonwealth golds.

questions.q: Which country did Nauru switch recognition to from Taiwan in 2024?
questions.why: It was one of Taiwan's last allies.

questions.q: Who became President of Nauru in 2023?
questions.why: He took office in October.

questions.q: What covers much of Nauru's interior after mining?
questions.why: About 80% of the land was mined.

questions.q: What is the main language of Nauru?
questions.why: English is widely used.

questions.q: Which sport is the most popular on Nauru?
questions.why: It was brought from Australia.

questions.q: Which sport has won Nauru many Commonwealth medals?
questions.why: It is a small country with strong lifters.

questions.q: How long is the ring road around Nauru?
questions.why: You can drive round in 30 minutes.

questions.q: Which lagoon in the south is a popular spot?
questions.why: It is the only inland water.

questions.q: What is Nauru's highest point?
questions.why: It is about 70 m high.

questions.q: Which fish do Nauruans traditionally farm in lagoons?
questions.why: They were kept in ponds.

questions.q: Which bird did Nauruans traditionally catch and tame?
questions.why: It was a sport.

questions.q: Which Japanese gun remains on Command Ridge?
questions.why: The Japanese built defences there.

questions.q: How many tribes are Nauruans traditionally split into?
questions.why: The flag's star has 12 points.

questions.q: Which airline is Nauru's national carrier?
questions.why: It flies to Brisbane.

questions.q: Which trust fund was meant to save phosphate money for the future?
questions.why: Much of it was lost in bad investments.

questions.q: Which 1990s scheme made Nauru a centre for offshore banking?
questions.why: Hundreds of banks were registered.

questions.q: What does the star on Nauru's flag show?
questions.a: Nauru's place just south of the equator
questions.why: The yellow line is the equator.
